subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding and operating with negative numbers on a number line
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student moves a virtual marker left/right on a number line extended below zero
exercise.pictorial: Student plots and compares pictured negative and positive values on a number line
exercise.abstract: Student orders and compares a mixed set of positive and negative numbers

misconception_flags: treats negative numbers as always smaller in magnitude rather than value (e.g. thinks -5 < -8)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
